exceptions.reason: Fixed only in minimatch 11, which drops the callable export that eslint, eslint-plugin-react, dir-compare and filelist still require. Reached only through eslint and electron-builder, which match the repository's own patterns at build time and are not packaged into the app.

Fixed in glob 14.0.2, but @electron/asar 4.3.0, its newest release, requires glob 13. Reached only through electron-builder at build time, where asar does not pass an AbortSignal, and not packaged into the app.
